text: So what’s the big question here? Is Weibo’s business holding up?

text: Good catch. The first quarter did beat, but that was largely due to a one-off recovery of a bad debt. The underlying trends are weaker.

text: So the beat was a bit of a mirage. What are the real headwinds they’re facing?

text: Management is positive about AI-related ad budgets and auto sector spending. But they’re cautious on smartphones and online games.

text: That’s a mixed picture. Why the caution on smartphones?

text: big operators aren’t launching many new titles.

text: So the ad market is fragmenting. How is Weibo responding?

text: They’re investing heavily in AI. They have tools for content creation, video generation, and search. But the report says monetization is still early stage.

text: That sounds like a classic squeeze: weaker revenue and higher spending. What does that mean for margins?

text: Exactly. The report forecasts operating profit to fall by 13% this year, with margins contracting by nearly five percentage points.

text: So the margin story is the key takeaway. What about the valuation?
